laws.title: Route is locator
laws.rule: A public Record route MUST remain an external locator bound to a logical Record identity and MUST NOT become that Record's ontological identity.

laws.title: Language realization is not Record identity
laws.rule: A language realization MUST remain a representation of one exact Record revision and MUST NOT mint a new RecordId merely because its language differs.

laws.title: R0.7 adds no RecordKinds
laws.rule: R0.7 MUST add zero RecordKinds; route and language bindings MUST remain identity-registry entries rather than ontology entities.

laws.title: Public paths are permanently reserved
laws.rule: Once a public path is admitted for a RecordId, that path MUST remain historically reserved to the same RecordId and MUST NOT be reassigned to another Record.

laws.title: Record route grammar is canonical
laws.rule: A Record route MUST use the frozen locale/namespace/slug grammar and MUST reject query strings, fragments, percent escapes, uppercase paths and trailing slashes as canonical identity.

laws.title: Locale is explicit in Record routes
laws.rule: Every R0.7 Record route MUST encode one admitted locale segment explicitly so canonical URLs do not depend on ambient browser language or hidden preference state.

laws.title: One canonical route per Record language
laws.rule: For each logical RecordId and language pair, the current route registry MUST contain exactly one canonical path whenever that pair has any registered paths.

laws.title: Aliases preserve target and language
laws.rule: A route alias MUST remain bound to the same logical RecordId and language as its historical binding and MUST NOT redirect to a different Record or language realization.

laws.title: Canonical moves preserve old locators
laws.rule: When a canonical route changes, the previous public path MUST remain registered as an alias or durable equivalent for the same RecordId and language.

laws.title: Route admission is historically pinned
laws.rule: Every route binding MUST record the exact target revision against which the path was admitted, while the path itself continues to identify the logical Record across later revisions.

laws.title: Language availability is revision-bound
laws.rule: A language binding MUST reference one exact Record revision, and a later Record head MUST NOT silently inherit a language realization admitted for an older revision.

laws.title: Canonical language binds canonical payload
laws.rule: The canonical language realization for an exact Record revision MUST bind the same PayloadDigest as that revision's canonical semantic payload.

laws.title: Translations identify their source language
laws.rule: A translation realization MUST bind the same exact target revision, MUST identify a different canonical source language, and MUST carry its own immutable realization digest.

laws.title: Translation cannot create semantic authority
laws.rule: Translated prose MAY render an existing Record but MUST NOT create a new Claim, Evidence binding, maturity classification or other semantic authority by translation alone.

laws.title: Translation is optional
laws.rule: A public Record MAY have only one language realization; R0.7 MUST NOT require bilingual publication or infer that a missing translation means private or unavailable knowledge.

laws.title: No implicit language fallback
laws.rule: If the requested language realization is not admitted for the exact current Record head, route resolution MUST report language unavailable and MUST NOT silently serve another language.

laws.title: Current language requires current head binding
laws.rule: When a Record advances to a new head revision, current language availability MUST require a language binding for that exact head before localized content may be treated as current.

laws.title: Unresolved route is not another Record
laws.rule: A path with no admitted route binding MUST resolve as unresolved and MUST NOT fall back to the landing page or another Record identity as an identity rule.

laws.title: R0.6 remains the exposure authority
laws.rule: Route and language resolution MUST NOT bypass R0.6 disclosure or lifecycle eligibility; a valid locator and language realization do not by themselves authorize public projection.

laws.title: Legacy migration remains deferred
laws.rule: R0.7 MUST NOT rewrite current Portfolio routes, client-side language behavior or public UI; mapping frozen legacy paths into the new registry remains R0.8 work.
